description: 霜白与雾蓝球面棚拍的修身圆领短袖，含版型微距与平铺空尺码表

styleLock.direction: cool blue-grey apparel studio commerce with spherical props and clean infographic bands
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat studio field per screen: seamless #FFFFFF for the main image, the silhouette comparison and the size-spec screen, mist-blue #A9C4E0 for the benefit hero and the trust close, soft #D7E5F2 for the scene, material and SKU screens, so no two neighbouring screens share a base field; a circular vignette window and polished sphere props are the only recurring set devices, no scenic depth, no gradient
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool even studio light around 6000K, large front-left softbox key with a right fill card, gentle wrap on knit, soft contact shadow only under hems and spheres, low specular highlights
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte #D7E5F2 studio floor, matte #FFFFFF counter board for flat lay, invisible torso form for worn screens so the garment keeps its own drape
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif as the single family, copy only inside clean reserved zones, Chinese copy rendered as short placeholder lines in 「」, no serif, no handwritten, no retro lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #1E2A44 inside outlined circles, one icon per row, no filled badges, no 3D icons
styleLock.presentationRules: worn screens always frame from the neck down so no face is needed; on-body and flat-lay scales never mix inside one screen; the same slight 3/4 torso reading repeats on benefit and SKU screens while the main image stays straight-on
noDrift: no visible model face or identity
no invented fabric percentages, gram weights, size numbers or test data
no floating props without contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool blue-grey apparel studio visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, mist-blue panel #A9C4E0, soft silver-blue field #D7E5F2 and ink-blue text #1E2A44; cool even studio light around 6000K with a large front-left softbox key, right fill card and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif as the single type family with copy only inside clean reserved zones; thin single-weight line icons in ink-blue #1E2A44 inside outlined circles; worn screens always framed from the neck down and flat-lay scale never mixed with on-body scale inside one screen; polished sphere props and one circular vignette window as the only recurring set devices; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented fabric percentages or size numbers.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清版型轮廓，干净合规可直接当主图

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with a right fill card, soft contact shadow under the hem
shots.whitespace: even margin all round the silhouette, no copy zone
shots.promptTemplate: Apparel product photography of {product} worn on an invisible torso form. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level front view, full garment squared to the frame and framed from the neck down so the shoulder line and waist reading stay clean. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key and a right fill card, soft contact shadow under the hem, on a seamless studio field #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even margin all round and no copy zone. Commercial e-commerce quality, crisp knit edges, real fabric texture, accurate drape weight. Negative: no visible face, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no gradient background, no cut-off sleeves or hem, no garment floating without a contact shadow.

Late-afternoon directional key light from the right at 6000K with a cool open-shade fill, a rim light tinted toward {accent_color}, long soft shadow falling to the left across a single flat studio cyclorama in soft silver-blue #D7E5F2 where wall and floor read as one sweep. shots.displayName: 背面走线与售后保障屏
shots.intent: 用背面缝线实景加三条留空服务条目收口，降低下单风险
shots.camera: photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, close-up crop across the upper back, rear yoke seam and hem stitching
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with a right rim, gentle seam definition, even clean tone
shots.background: smooth mist-blue field #A9C4E0 with a translucent information band #FFFFFF across the lower third
shots.props: three outlined circle icons on the information band
shots.whitespace: lower third reserved as clean band whitespace for the three rows
shots.textZone: 下三分之一信息带内三条图标行
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen. A close-up crop across the upper back of {product} photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, showing the rear yoke seam line, the shoulder articulation and the hem stitching. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft front-left key with a right rim and gentle definition along the seams, over a smooth mist-blue field #A9C4E0 carrying a translucent information band #FFFFFF across the lower third. Three service rows sit in that band, each one outlined circle icon in ink-blue #1E2A44 plus a short label reading 「{callout_6}」, 「{callout_7}」 and 「{callout_8}」, with every number, date and carrier name left blank. The detail crop occupies 55-60% of the frame in the upper zone, the lower third kept as clean whitespace for the rows. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, warranty periods or test data, no real courier or platform marks, no QR code, no dense body text, no visible face, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 7 张切片逐屏事实：①封面屏——成年男模腰上裁切，炭灰圆领短袖修身上衣，跳绳挂颈作运动氛围道具，冷调蓝灰渐变底＋三颗悬浮球体＋圆形暗角开窗，顶部两行大字标题、左上角 LOGO 占位、右下角一行小注；②商品信息屏——白卡上的衣服尺码表（肩宽／胸围／袖长／下摆／衣长五列、六行号型实测数值）＋薄厚／版型／弹力／柔软四条指数选择条；③④原料叙事屏——白色编织篮盛蓬松原棉纤维与两枚干棉桃，柔焦白色层架背景，上下两组大标题＋小标；④⑤颜色分类屏——版型标题与颜色分类小标之下是 2×2 上身裁切宫格（同款同姿势只换色），白格压蓝底，旁有超大英文装饰字；⑤⑥产品展示屏——一大四小的上身裁切拼贴（正面、侧身抱臂、背面下摆），蓝色色块压角＋斜体英文装饰字；⑥⑦售后屏——淡蓝信息带上的编号圆圈条目（三行服务说明，含一枚单字圆形徽标）。品类判定依据：主体是成年男模外穿的圆领短袖针织上衣，不是童模、不是下装、也不是贴身内衣或家居服，跳绳与运动感的身体语言只是搭配道具，因此按图判定为 男装／上衣，与源文件夹名「男装」一致，无需改判。已剥离内容：素材站品牌字与两处二维码黑底引流贴片、平台与店铺字样、原模特面部身份、原大标题与指数文案原句、尺码表全部实测数值与号型数字（改为留空网格 {callout_3} 与留空属性行 {callout_4}）、原料产地与纤维成分与克重表述（微距屏只写视觉事实并显式禁止成分百分比）、售后条目中的天数与时效数字（改为三条留空标签 {callout_6}、{callout_7}、{callout_8}）。与库内近似模版（薄荷绿系的基础款圆领短袖、青碧黄系修身白色圆领短袖）差异点：1）色彩与背景系统整体换成净白 #FFFFFF／雾蓝 #A9C4E0／银蓝 #D7E5F2 三级冷蓝交替，并以金属球体道具与圆形暗角开窗作唯一套内装置，近似款均无此装置；2）机位体系改为上身裁切为主，新增 90 度侧身双格对比、膝部低角度仰拍、90 度顶视平铺与背面 45 度育克裁切，不再以挂拍与 invisible form 排列为主体；3）分镜角色新增独立的原料纤维静物特写屏与 2×2 上身色卡屏，尺码屏只留空网格并删除指数条与参数卡，收口镜改为背面走线实景加三条留空服务条目，而非促销收口。
